rationale: iter #1061 (default HPs, lr=1e-3, dropout=0.1, wd=1e-4, epochs=40) remains the iTransformer high-water mark (W1 39%/+77% ann, W6 37%/+500% ann — both within 1-3pp of WR floor, avg_ann +73%). This iter #1072 confirmed that the OPPOSITE direction (more regularization: dropout=0.2, wd=5e-4, epochs=60) regresses badly (0/7, avg_wr 25.2%, ~2× trade count). Train mode should sweep the UNDERFITTING direction next: smaller dim (64), shallower depth (2), shorter epochs (25), lower dropout (0.05) — keep lr in the 5e-4 to 2e-3 band where #1061's defaults sit. pos_weight in [0.3, 0.8] is also unexplored and could lift WR by under-predicting positives.
